statement: Inclusive limits bound each file to 1 MiB, snapshot contents to 8 MiB, direct input reads plus every examined directory entry (including ignored entries) to 4096 visits, and logical UTF-8 names to 1 MiB. Files are validated before retention; all biome, placement, piece and species loader reads use the captured bytes. Contract and CLI regressions cover inclusive scan bounds for structure types, pieces and species, ignored files and directories, disabled terrain features, rooted and nonportable names, and snapshot-reader failures. Aggregate-limit fixtures contain valid JSON regardless of traversal order, including exactly 8 MiB and one byte beyond it.
